nodes.label: Android and iOS release targets
nodes.rationale: Other platform folders are development scaffolding.

nodes.label: Bounded image inputs
nodes.rationale: Bound inputs to 25 MB, 24 megapixels, and one frame; normalized lossless PNG snapshot is capped at 6 megapixels.

nodes.label: Calibration hash preservation
nodes.rationale: Calibration updates change the hash while saved results retain original provenance.

nodes.label: Experimental pH estimates
nodes.rationale: Results, history, and reports identify readings as unvalidated estimates; the app is not an independently validated instrument.

nodes.label: Explicit PDF sharing
nodes.rationale: User explicitly invokes PDF sharing; photos leave through the operating system share sheet and OS backups follow device settings.

nodes.label: Measurement provenance
nodes.rationale: Each new saved record retains calibration hash, algorithm version, colors, warnings, source, and measurement time.

nodes.label: Offline edge computing
nodes.rationale: No API key, account, .env asset, cloud strip recognition, or network call is needed.

nodes.label: Optional reference background
nodes.rationale: Disabling reference paper produces an explicit fixed-background warning.

nodes.label: Owned image cleanup
nodes.rationale: Use UUID files under app documents and clean owned temporary and orphan files conservatively.

nodes.label: Region of interest extraction
nodes.rationale: Drawing and accessible move/resize controls select the same normalized still-image pixels.

nodes.label: Regression suite
nodes.rationale: Synthetic tests cover calibration, image geometry, offline checks, provenance, legacy records, storage errors, demo behavior, and PDF generation, but do not replace device or lab validation.

nodes.label: Robust color mean
nodes.rationale: Discard darkest 5% and brightest 5% of dye pixels.

nodes.label: Snapshot ROI coordinates
nodes.rationale: Every ROI refers to the same normalized snapshot; analysis decodes once for prediction and thumbnails.

nodes.label: Still image capture
nodes.rationale: Camera permission failures show an error and never substitute a demo photo.

nodes.label: Empirical uncertainty calibration
nodes.rationale: Calibrate uncertainty empirically; never transform raw color distance into percentage confidence without evidence.

nodes.label: Holdout threshold evaluation
nodes.rationale: Tune rejection thresholds only on development data, then evaluate untouched holdout data.

nodes.label: Independent validation split
nodes.rationale: Separate calibration/training and validation images by phone, lot, and session to avoid near-duplicate leakage; test the complete workflow.

nodes.label: Intended operating envelope
nodes.rationale: Specify strip brand and lot, valid pH interval, sample types, timing, reference paper, lighting, and phones; do not infer reference pH from household substance labels.

nodes.label: Measurement acceptance metrics
nodes.rationale: Specify acceptable error, bias, repeatability, and rejection rates before evaluation; report counts, MAE, signed bias, high-percentile absolute error, repeatability, accepted/rejected counts and subgroup results.

nodes.label: Negative and adverse captures
nodes.rationale: Include repeats, blank or non-strip negatives, glare, shadows, motion blur, and out-of-range samples.

nodes.label: Owner validation release gate
nodes.rationale: Owner approves written validation report and operating envelope; retain unvalidated labeling and avoid accuracy or suitability claims until then. No reference dataset or independently measured results were supplied.

nodes.label: Paired reference measurements
nodes.rationale: Collect paired strip photographs and independent reference measurements, preserving raw images, snapshots, ROIs, versions, device, lot, lighting, timing, and reference provenance.

nodes.label: CIELAB spline matching
nodes.rationale: On-device acquisition checks reject colors too far from calibration and flag ambiguous or boundary matches.

nodes.label: Provisional quality thresholds
nodes.rationale: Color distance 15, ambiguity within 1 Lab distance at least 1 pH away, luminance 40–230, and clipping 20% require independent validation.

nodes.label: Calibration anchors
nodes.rationale: Eight experimental anchors define the supported domain; candidate search stays within that domain.

nodes.label: Calibration schema 1
nodes.rationale: Require nonempty ID, positive integer version, positive finite max_color_distance, and at least two unique finite pH anchors with integer RGB channels.

nodes.label: Numerical pH resolution
nodes.rationale: Candidates at 0.1 pH intervals include exact anchors and endpoints; one decimal display is numerical resolution, not accuracy.

nodes.label: Accessibility acceptance
nodes.rationale: Test large text, screen readers, move/resize controls, small phones, reduced motion, Unicode notes, and iPad sharing.

nodes.label: Android production application ID
nodes.rationale: Owner supplies registered PH_APPLICATION_ID; debug namespace remains unchanged.

nodes.label: Android release signing
nodes.rationale: Provide local ignored android/key.properties or protected CI secrets; no signing material is included.

nodes.label: Beta rollout and rollback
nodes.rationale: Start with small beta, monitor actionable user diagnostics, keep known-good build and preserve schema compatibility.

nodes.label: Device lifecycle acceptance
nodes.rationale: Test permissions, background/resume, rotation, initialization navigation, gallery cancellation, save/reopen/share, offline behavior, and interrupted Android picking on real Android and iOS devices.

nodes.label: Diagnostic privacy
nodes.rationale: Local diagnostics exclude image bytes, notes, paths and exception messages; no cloud telemetry.

nodes.label: iOS production identity
nodes.rationale: Owner must select registered production bundle ID and signing profile; existing development identity remains, while CI compiles without codesigning.

nodes.label: Offline bundle inspection
nodes.rationale: Inspect release bundles for .env or credentials and merged Android manifests for Internet or microphone permission introduced by dependencies.

nodes.label: Pixel geometry acceptance
nodes.rationale: Confirm ROIs, thumbnails, overlays, and PDF annotations agree across portrait, landscape, and EXIF-rotated photos.

nodes.label: Previously distributed key revocation
nodes.rationale: Owner must rotate or revoke any previously distributed Gemini keys; deleting them from the current build does not revoke old copies.

nodes.label: Result labeling acceptance
nodes.rationale: Camera failure cannot create a demo implicitly; demo, unvalidated, and legacy labels persist in storage and sharing.

nodes.label: Storage failure acceptance
nodes.rationale: Test corruption, missing data, exhaustion, interruptions, older records, orphan cleanup and deletion; do not erase history to hide failures.

nodes.label: Unsigned compilation validation
nodes.rationale: Normal release fails for missing/example application ID or incomplete signing; PH_UNSIGNED_VALIDATION=true is compile-only and artifacts must not be distributed.

nodes.label: Local diagnostics
nodes.rationale: Only bounded error types, stages, and timestamps are kept locally and copyable from Settings; no telemetry upload.

nodes.label: Pinned development toolchain
nodes.rationale: Checked toolchain is Flutter 3.41.6 and Dart 3.11.4; CI uses the same Flutter version.

nodes.label: Explicit demo mode
nodes.rationale: Bundled reference photographs are used only through explicit demo selection; results remain labeled.

nodes.label: Legacy history compatibility
nodes.rationale: Read existing Hive records as legacy estimates with unknown validation; report unreadable storage as an error without automatic destructive reset.
